test_fixed_eigen_matrix: test pybind11 fixed-size Eigen matrix row-major and column-major creation and copy operations
test_dense_eigen_matrix: test pybind11 dynamic-size dense Eigen matrix row-major and column-major creation and copy operations
test_eigen_return_references: test pybind11 Eigen matrix return patterns including get, view, copy, ref, block, and corners methods
test_eigen_ref_mutators: test pybind11 Eigen::Ref mutator functions that modify NumPy arrays in place via row-major and column-major refs
test_sparse_eigen_matrix: test pybind11 sparse Eigen matrix CSR and CSC creation and copy operations using scipy sparse matrices
